# When money moves, does it arrive?


Brokerage account transfers move through a chain of manual handoffs: a receiving firm, DTCC and ACATS, a delivering firm, plus regulatory checks for AML, KYC, and customer protection. Over the last 24 months, that chain produced 116,000 improper transfer rejections and delays stretching past 100 days. RPA bots and stateless microservices weren’t built for a process that runs for weeks. They forget context between retries, and a retry is not a rollback.


Grid Dynamics built something different. AI-powered brokerage account transfers now run on an Agentic AI control plane, backed by durable execution and a bitemporal database.[Temporal’s durable execution workflows](https://www.griddynamics.com/solutions/temporal-agentic-ai-platform) hold the transfer’s full state across every handoff and resume exactly where they left off after a failure.[XTDB’s bitemporal database](https://www.griddynamics.com/solutions/agentic-ai-regulatory-compliance-starter-kit) records both when an event happened and when it was recorded, so any transfer can be reconstructed audit-ready, step by step. The control plane applies deterministic rules to the regulatory calls and routes judgment calls, like a name mismatch that trips FINRA 11870, to an AI agent for a recommendation and a human for approval.


Watch two live transfers, one clean, one exception, both handled by the same durable workflow without losing a single state transition.
